authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6849.1 dhūma gives the smoke family dhum/dum and dhua/dhuwa, including northern dūm and eastern dhuā̃. The addendum gives Gujarati/Kachchi dhũāṛo, but that and northern t- or ŋ-containing variants require specific local development or subsection review. Joint survey comparison leaves inheritance versus transfer between Indo-Aryan languages open.
